offering_description.value: Provides secured pawn loans and consumer installment loans to individuals, and sells used merchandise from its stores and online. It serves cash-needing consumers and shoppers through owned pawn stores and lending operations.

primary_products.value: used jewelry; consumer electronics; tools; general used merchandise

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers seeking pawn loans, installment credit, and used merchandise

end_markets.value: consumer finance; secondhand retail; jewelry and precious metals

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: pawn service charges and consumer loan interest; product sales: used merchandise sold from forfeited pledges and purchases

value_chain_position.value: service provider: pawn and lending services taken from consumers, sold to individual borrowers; retailer: buys and resells used merchandise to individual shoppers; financial intermediary: extends installment loans to individual consumers

geography_served.value: North America: US nationwide, Mexico and Guatemala

specialization.value: related lines: pawn loans, used merchandise retail, and consumer installment loans

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated pawn stores in the US and Latin America; online: online sales of used merchandise

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer lending and pawn licenses from state regulators, CFPB, and Mexican financial regulators
